card.name: Section-number dots and pay words
card.fires_on: The decimal point inside label cross-references such as (5.1) or (14.2), and pay words like pay or compensation after worker or CEO in economic text.

modes.label: Section reference dot
modes.description: The period after the main section number in a bracketed cross-reference in a drug label.

modes.label: Executive pay terms
modes.description: Pay or compensation following workers' or CEO in inequality discussions.

modes.label: Inside long words
modes.description: Endings of longer words such as extractive or toxicology.
